title: Playing three sessions a day in the restaurant
summary: The restaurant job meant playing light classical music at lunch and supper, and only dance music late.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You mentioned playing in a restaurant. But when would you start? You started in the afternoon and played...

Well, we played a lunch session, you know, like from 12 to 1:30 or 12 to 2, something like that, you know. Then you'd come back and play from 6 to maybe 7:30 or 8, you know. Then you would come back again at maybe 10 o'clock, play from 10 to 11, 12, to 1 o'clock, and that's it. Three sessions a day, you know.
What did you do in between?
And that was all for dancing, right? They would have the dance floor and the rest of it?

Actually, there wasn't really any dancing, except the late show. The rest of it was just playing music for people to eat by, you know. That's why we played light music, the Classical things and things like that, you know. We finally got run out of that town. Heh-heh.
